reading.body:
FiberState publishes no power capacity or square footage for its Salt Lake City data center. The operator's website describes the facility as offering colocation, dedicated servers, peering, and IP transit services with named carrier and exchange partners, but does not state the data center's physical location or size. No compute density or IT load can be estimated from published data.

Utah has 21 mapped data center facilities, of which 9 publish power capacity totaling 52.18 MW. FiberState's ranking at position 10 by published megawatts reflects the fact that it publishes no specification at all, placing it below the nine facilities with disclosed capacity. The state's published capacity is thin, and most mapped facilities here disclose no figures.

Without published power, footprint, or utilization data, this facility cannot be assessed for relevance to AI infrastructure scaling. The operator should publish its capacity to enable evaluation.
